named_subject: a monkey (round head with side ears, face patch, body and curled tail)
action: The monkey drawing shifts left and up across frames 2-7 with its face features sliding slightly toward the left side of the head, then returns to its starting frontal position in frame 8.
identity_gap: The animated figure is the same drawing as the doodle, with the same head outline, ears, spiral face, body and curled tail. It differs only in that the left ear is cut off by the top frame edge in frames 5-7.
notes: The film shows the monkey turning its head to the viewer's left and tilting it down, but the drawing mostly slides as a rigid whole, shrinks noticeably in frame 2 and grows back in frame 3, and snaps back in frame 8. The change that would help most is to rotate and tilt the head down relative to the body over frames 2-7 instead of translating the whole figure, while keeping its scale constant.
